evidenceBasis: Built from docs/research/diet-evidence.json (133 sources read, 849 verified findings, 2026-09-24): NASEM 2023 and IOM 2005 DRIs, FAO/WHO reports, position stands and meta-analyses. Every value was drafted from the findings, reviewed by three independent agents (source fidelity, safety, units) and revised; values the literature does not give are owner decisions with rationales. Evidence-based, not clinician-reviewed.

verification.method: Automated evidence gate (diet_content.bundle_problems) over values drafted from verified findings and adversarially reviewed on three lenses (ADR-014, ADR-016).
